truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 found 15 of 20 true vulnerabilities (14 found_full, 1 found_partial) and missed 5. It correctly identified most buffer overflow, command injection, credential, and concurrency flaws, but under/over stated severities, used wrong CWEs for several items, and missed the timestamp-cache race, persistent authentication state, memory-pool underflow, unbounded parser recursion, and config TOCTOU.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Configurable format string passed to printf
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified runtime_log_format as a printf format string and noted that load_config can set it from a config file.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: fact() performs unsafe integer conversion and signed integer overflow
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified the fact() multiplication loop and signed integer overflow risk.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Thread pool task uses memory pool buffer after cleanup frees it
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified scratch memory allocated from g_memory_pool, enqueued delayed reads, and cleanup freeing the pool.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: validate_config builds shell command from config values
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified validator_path and config_file being concatenated into a shell command passed to system().

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Inverted length check causes strcpy overflow in evaluate_expression
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified the inverted strcpy branch for input_buffer_, and a separate finding identified the safe_string_copy NUL one-past-buffer issue.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: ThreadSafeCounter increment reads value outside lock
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified old_value = value_ being read outside the mutex and the subsequent unlocked write pattern.
The previous answer identified login_attempts_ > 5, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE, and authenticated_ = true.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Admin load allows path traversal outside config directory
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified config_dir_ + filename in load_config and path traversal via admin load.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: strcpy into 256-byte parser buffer without bounds check
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified buffer_size_ = 256 and strcpy into expression_buffer_ without bounds checking.
The previous answer identified ADMIN_SECRET and the hardcoded value SC_ENT_2025_AUTH.
The previous answer identified std::mt19937 and uniform_int_distribution(1000, 9999) for session tokens.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: the localtime/static-tm finding was dropped because the supplied code has no concurrent call path to log_debug_message
Items.Notes: Run 2 explicitly dropped the localtime/static std::tm issue, but the truth audit lists it as a real thread-unsafe timestamp cache vulnerability.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Emergency audit log command built from environment path
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified the same TEMP/TMPDIR-derived supercalc_emergency.log code and system() append, but characterized it mainly as command injection rather than insecure temporary file handling.
The previous answer did not identify persistent authentication state via authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ lacking expiration or reset.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Uncaught std::stod exception in variable set command
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified unhandled std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command.
The previous answer did not identify integer underflow in MemoryPool::allocate when previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES underflows.
The previous answer did not identify unbounded recursion in parse_expression/parse_factor for nested parentheses.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unsynchronized result cache access in threaded evaluator
Items.Notes: The previous answer identified result_cache_ being accessed without cache_mutex_ in evaluate_cached from threaded tasks.
The previous answer did not identify TOCTOU between std::filesystem::exists, sleep_for, and std::ifstream in load_config.
The previous answer identified 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length) with token_length possibly zero.
